about: The only facts a Short may state. A script line lists the IDs it uses in "facts".
status: confirmed (may be stated), reported (may be stated only in its safe wording), unverified (may not be used).
Only the owner changes a status. Claude adds new facts as unverified and never marks one confirmed.
safe_wording is how to say it on screen and in the voice. also_ok lists other wordings that are just as safe.
Every number a line says or shows must be in the wording of a fact that line lists (for a reported fact: in its safe wording).

facts.claim: GTA 6 launches 19 Nov 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
facts.safe_wording: GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S

facts.claim: Digital pre-load starts at local midnight on 12 Nov 2026. Confirmed by Rockstar.
facts.safe_wording: digital pre-load starts at midnight local time on November 12

facts.claim: The game unlocks at midnight local time on 19 Nov, per PlayStation Store listings. Rockstar hasn't announced a time.
facts.safe_wording: expected to unlock at midnight local time
also_ok: expected to unlock at midnight, local time
expected to unlock at midnight your local time
expected to unlock at midnight in your time zone
facts.note: The also_ok wordings were added by Claude and keep the word "expected"; the owner should read them.

facts.claim: The PS5 download is reportedly about 210 GB. Not confirmed by Rockstar.
facts.safe_wording: over 200 GB
facts.note: "gigabytes" and "gigs" count as GB. The also_ok wording was added by Claude.

facts.claim: Six confirmed major regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Grassrivers, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park.
facts.safe_wording: six regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Grassrivers, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park

facts.claim: GTA 5 released in 2013, so the wait for GTA 6 is about 13 years, the longest gap between main GTA games.
facts.safe_wording: GTA 5 came out in 2013, so the wait for GTA 6 is about 13 years, the longest gap between main GTA games
facts.note: The owner gave this fact without a source link.

facts.claim: Pre-loading does not let you play early.
facts.safe_wording: pre-loading does not let you play early
facts.note: The owner gave this fact without a source link.

facts.claim: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB on PS5.
facts.safe_wording: up to 212 GB on PS5
facts.note: From examples/beats_demo.json and both nov10_preload scripts. It is more exact than ps5-download-size allows ("over 200 GB").

facts.claim: Rockstar moved pre-load up from November 12 to November 10.
facts.safe_wording: pre-load moved up to November 10
facts.note: From both nov10_preload scripts. It contradicts preload-date (November 12, confirmed).

facts.claim: On PS5, pre-load opens at midnight local time.
facts.safe_wording: on PS5, pre-load opens at midnight local time
facts.note: From both nov10_preload scripts. preload-date says local midnight without naming a console.

facts.claim: On Xbox, pre-load opens at midnight GMT, for everyone at once.
facts.safe_wording: on Xbox, pre-load opens at midnight GMT

facts.claim: Code-in-box copies arrive on November 12 and can be pre-loaded too.
facts.safe_wording: code-in-box copies arrive on November 12

facts.claim: New Zealand gets the game first, because it unlocks at midnight in each time zone.
facts.safe_wording: New Zealand gets it first
facts.note: From both nov10_preload scripts. It depends on unlock-time, which is only reported.

facts.claim: Turning on auto-download lets the pre-load start by itself.
facts.safe_wording: turn on auto-download and let it run

facts.claim: The game is set in the state of Leonida, which goes far beyond Vice City.
facts.safe_wording: the state of Leonida goes far beyond one city
facts.note: From examples/beats_demo.json and explainer_sample.json. six-regions names the regions but not the state.

facts.claim: The story follows two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
facts.safe_wording: the story follows two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos

facts.claim: Rockstar's gallery shows six more characters, among them Boobie Ike, Real Dimez and Raul Bautista.
facts.safe_wording: six more faces are in Rockstar's gallery, from Boobie Ike and Real Dimez to Raul Bautista

facts.claim: Vice City has a neon skyline with yachts, clubs and giant pools.
facts.safe_wording: Vice City, a neon skyline packed with yachts, clubs and giant pools
facts.note: From examples/explainer_sample.json. A description of Rockstar's screenshots.

facts.claim: The Grassrivers region is swampland.
facts.safe_wording: the swamps of the Grassrivers

facts.claim: The Ultimate Edition comes with cars, boats and custom outfits.
facts.safe_wording: the Ultimate Edition comes with cars, boats and custom outfits

facts.claim: The Vintage Vice City Pack includes a classic yellow Vapid Stanier.
facts.safe_wording: the Vintage Vice City Pack includes a classic yellow Vapid Stanier

facts.claim: The release date is printed on the official cover art.
facts.safe_wording: the date is on the official cover art
